parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the cooling of hot water from different initial temperatures. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Experiment A Pour 100 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Place the thermometer in the water in the beaker. In the first row of Table 2.1, record the temperature θ A of the water at time t = 0 s and immediately start the stop-watch. Record, in Table 2.1, the temperature θ A of the water at times t = 30 s, t = 60 s, t = 90 s, t = 120 s, t = 150 s and t = 180 s. [1] Empty the beaker.

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Experiment B Pour 100 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Place the thermometer in the water in the beaker. Wait until the temperature θ B of the water has reached the same value as the temperature θ A at t = 90 s in Experiment A . In the first row of Table 2.1, record this temperature θ B of the water at time t = 0 s and immediately start the stop-watch.
